Alongside the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deal, we have already featured some notable Black Friday in July MacBook Pro deals, some of the best of which coming courtesy of Amazon and B&H. You’ll find these configurations highlighted below as well, but we also wanted to highlight the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro model that is $300 off at Amazon right now.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 245GB of RAM and the 1TB internal storage capacity down at $2,699 shipped.

We are looking at the most affordable 2TB machine you can buy carrying the 15-core CPU/16-core GPU internals – the upgraded 18-core model is selling for $2,960, or $239 off, for the record.

This model now carries a near $3,000 list price and is currently available on Amazon at $300 off – the best deal we have tracked since the recent price increases.

Yes, there was a time when this machine was sold for less than this, but those days are long gone and if you are looking to upgrade in 2026, this is $300 off no matter how you look at it.

Get in on Black Friday in July Apple Watch Series 11 deals from $299 before they go out of stock ($100 off)

There’s still plenty of summer left out there and if you’re still looking to land yourself a new Apple wearable you might want to get in there while the most popular Series 11 models are $100 off the list prices.

We caught a number of special deals on the more expensive premium Apple Watch Series 11 configurations over the last week or so, but if you’re looking towards the most affordable and, frankly, best value in the lineup if you ask me, the base models at $100 off are where it’s at:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

As of this morning/the time of writing, Amazon’s stock on the base aluminum 42mm and 46mm Series 11 models is still sitting at $100 off the list prices. We are, however, starting to see select case colors going out of stock on the larger 46mm form-factor and you might want to scope out the situation before prices start to jump back up on you.

These deals are largely on par with the best we have tracked since release, save for the June Prime Day festivities when select models were $20 less than we have here today. But with the Black Friday in July deals set to start wrapping up over this upcoming weekend, we might very well see the deals on these Apple Watch Series 11 models follow suit and, in fact, we are already starting to.

Heads up! Satechi’s 25W Space Black metal 3-in-1 MagSafe stand is one of the best, now at $78 all-time low (40% off)

Okay, here we go folks, my personal favorite new 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging station just dropped to the lowest price ever…again. The Space Black metal Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Wireless Charging Station is now down at $77.99 shipped on Amazon.

The official Satechi Amazon storefront is getting particularly aggressive with deal pricing on its latest 2026 Qi2 25W MagSafe Charging Station today down at $77.99 shipped.

This is a regularly $130 premium charging unit that is now seeing a, frankly, giant 40% price drop.

We just saw this model drop to a new low for Prime Day at $104, then again more recently to $91, but it has now dropped again over at Amazon to deliver what I would consider one of the best values in the 25W MagSafe charging station game.

There are cheaper 25W stations out there, but there’s nothing as high-quality as this one in a price range as low as we are seeing here today if you ask me.

You’re looking at an all Space Black metal finish here with clean lines that makes for one of the most sleek and attractive desktop power solutions in the game. It, of course, features the main 25W MagSafe pad atop the articulating arm for ideal viewing angles, as well as a slick pop out Apple Watch charger around back and the Qi pad on the base for your AirPods.

You can check out our launch coverage for more details, but the short-form takeaway is you’re looking at the best price on one of the best in class options on the market.

Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2 now $100 off for Black Friday in July (All colors)

Alongside the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 and the return all-time low on the new AirTag 2, one of the better Black Friday in July deals knocks $100 off the 2026 AirPods Max 2.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s latest AirPods Max 2 down at $449 shipped, which is a straight up $100 off the $549 list price for the best deal around right now.

This deal is live on all five colors: Midnight, Blue, Orange, Starlight, and Orange.

You’re looking at the lowest price we have tracked on the latest-generation Apple over-ears outside of the short-lived Prime Day price that saw most colors going out of stock before the event even ended. Today’s deal is the only other time we have seen them at better than $50 off since release earlier this year.

With the major summer shopping season typically culminating around the July Prime Day event that was bumped a month earlier this year, this 2026 Black Friday in July price might very well be the best deal we track on Max 2 before the fall. If you’re looking to land a set for the summer and beyond still, the $100 off might very well be the best price we see until the Black Friday deal season kicks into overdrive (or, more likely, the very early Black Friday deal season that, as of late, starts to kick in come October).

They look the same as the previous AirPods Max (USB-C), but there are notable upgrades under the hood here starting with the H2 chip.
